step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates News UK's serverless content API used to render web pages. Incoming user traffic resolves via Route 53 to CloudFront, which passes through AWS WAF rules where malicious traffic is dropped. Valid requests reach API Gateway, which invokes a Custom Authorizer Lambda. This authorizer communicates bidirectionally with an external Auth Service to retrieve capabilities and scopes. Once authorized, API Gateway forwards the request to a GraphQL Lambda, which either serves data from cache or queries the underlying datastore (e.g., RDS, Elasticsearch, domain APIs). Generic human actor stick figures are pruned, and all AWS services and third-party systems are mapped strictly to valid vocabulary terms.

graph.name: News UK Serverless Content API Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture for rendering content pages for News UK publications using Route 53, CloudFront, WAF, API Gateway, custom authorization Lambda with an external auth service, GraphQL Lambda, and flexible datastores.

nodes.name: CLOUDFRONT
nodes.notes: CDN distribution receiving requests from Route 53.

nodes.name: WAF
nodes.notes: Web Application Firewall inspecting traffic and dropping malicious requests.

nodes.name: API GATEWAY
nodes.notes: API Gateway managing incoming requests and triggering authentication.

nodes.name: CUSTOM AUTHORISER
nodes.notes: Lambda function executing custom authorization logic.

nodes.name: AUTH SERVICE
nodes.notes: External auth service providing user capabilities and scopes.

nodes.name: GraphQL
nodes.notes: Lambda function serving GraphQL queries from cache or backend stores.

nodes.name: DATASTORE
nodes.notes: Backend data store comprising internal databases, Elasticsearch, or domain APIs.

edges.notes: Route 53 routes incoming requests to CloudFront distribution.
CloudFront sends traffic through WAF rules.
WAF forwards validated requests to API Gateway.
API Gateway triggers Custom Authorizer Lambda.
Custom Authorizer contacts external Auth Service.
Auth Service returns scopes and capabilities to Custom Authorizer.
Custom Authorizer passes authorization result back to API Gateway.
API Gateway forwards authorized request with context to GraphQL Lambda.
GraphQL Lambda fetches required content from the Datastore.
